snippet.title: Senior Garden Guide
snippet.description:
Finding peace in the garden shouldn’t hurt your back—or your wallet. At Senior Garden Guide, we help brand-new senior gardeners grow fresh food and flowers in a gentle, healing, and budget-friendly way.
Our approach is simple and senior-first: clear step-by-step lessons, safe posture and movement tips, and calm pacing you can follow without rushing. We focus on the basics that matter—choosing the right, resilient varieties, caring for plants the easy way, and setting up low-maintenance beds and containers. You’ll also learn money-saving habits like seed starting, composting, regrowing kitchen scraps, and smart seasonal timing.
This channel is for beginners, older adults with limited mobility or arthritis, caregivers helping a loved one, and anyone who wants a soothing hobby that also trims the grocery bill. We keep instructions large-print on screen, speak slowly, and repeat the key steps so you never feel left behind.
